title: The two-hub reader tariff is 54
body:
## Summary
- Six reader premises need two queries, so 21 rows force charge `2 · (15 + 12) = 54`.
- The published nine plane charges sum to 54, twelve above the 42-port baseline.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no factorization search.
